status: Qualified release payloads; publication is recorded separately after upload verification.

source_scope.included: Paid casts, potions, taming, stable pet and hero references, co-op return projection, save-state gaps, later trap registration, spell-sound teardown, Forward+ Mirror scene reflections, combat-aware health visibility.
source_scope.isolation: Prepared from the prior release in a separate checkout. Pending menu, first-person, stamina, control, health-bar animation and other unrelated edits remain in the original working checkout.
source_scope.development_suite: 488 checks in lia-save-repair-2026-10-11.json; not added to the packaged totals. The packaged suite has 487 because the first-person self-bar control belongs to excluded pending camera work.

environment.linux: Ubuntu 24.04, NVIDIA RTX 3090 Ti, existing twelve-patch Godot 4.7 release runtime. Forward+ visual checks; headless save checks.
environment.android: Retroid Pocket 5, Android 13, Adreno 650, Compatibility; private QA application with the public compiled game scripts except one fixture entry hook.
environment.network: Real loopback ENet guest returns and late trap registration; a separate process using the previous public package verifies protocol refusal.
environment.isolation: Disposable desktop XDG profiles; Android private app and profile restored, public app untouched.
environment.performance: Functional checks; no new performance claim. Some independent checks ran concurrently.

rendered_reflections.limits: Fixed prepared cameras in gz3g/zone3obr after Gipat village, not the exact original screenshot camera. Four tree-fixture orbit samples cross terrain and are excluded from motion acceptance; the independent fixed-position angle sweep is the accepted motion control.

protocol_compatibility.result: Protocol 14 client receives explicit refusal and is not admitted to protocol 15 host.

build.native_binaries: Previous qualified desktop and Android runtimes/helpers reused without changes. macOS uses the official universal template and script navigation.

shutdown_followup.packaged_result: The combined cloud/wave/wind/reflection scene exits normally in 24.52 seconds with the final packaged Linux build; no errors or warnings.
shutdown_followup.prior_failures: Development stock and eleven-patch runtime shutdown timeouts remain recorded in lia-save-repair-2026-10-11.json. Both runtime and isolated source differ from that development checkout, so this does not assign a precise cause or claim all shutdown configurations repaired.

excluded_attempts.reason: Health-bar selection retained two animation-cache references without their fields; removed before the accepted import, exports and all packaged checks.

All 18 behavior checks passed but immediate tar readback raced restoration. Later readback matched all 55 original files. Runner now waits for verified restoration; android-fields-final passed with cleanup. The first run is excluded from accepted counts.

limits: Prepared save states and loopback networking are not full campaign-route or multi-machine acceptance.
Windows and macOS are cross-built and archive-audited; execution on those operating systems was not tested. macOS is unsigned and not notarized.
Android checks cover Compatibility on one Retroid Pocket 5; Mobile/Vulkan execution was not tested for this package.
Mirror geometry reflections apply to Forward+ and one selected nearby water plane; other paths retain screen-space tracing.
Story checkpoint/debug controls remain outside this release.
